text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—They've entered the final stretch!!
Every Umamusume is launching their last spurt!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Is it about time—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (Ngh...! This sheer aura...!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――OOOOAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Vodka is moving up!!
Vodka takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A Tiara route Umamusume has done it!!
Vodka did it!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: HELL YEAAAAAAHHH!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I am... the Derby Umamusume!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! Incredible~~~~!!
A Tiara Umamusume winning the Derby for the first time in 64 years!!
We just witnessed history~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You were seriously so cool...!!
It somehow gave me courage...!!
Congratulations, Vodka!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Times have really changed~~!
From now on, the truly strong Umamusume are gonna stay on top!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ......Thus, our oath hath been fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I bore witness, Vodka.
To your... devastation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Well done.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: You are my............—pride.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Hahaha...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(I can't stop shaking...
Is this... the true power of the "Storm"...?!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I'm... in luck...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(...Vodka-san.
You are without a doubt
a "great tempest" that brings total devastation.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(They'll keep running historic races and
grow even stronger than they are today—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (However, I...—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Dream Journey, who suffered a narrow defeat against Vodka."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, when she returned to the waiting room after it was all over,
she showed not a trace of frustration,
remaining eerily calm..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Vodka is without a doubt the "storm" of an Umamusume I was hoping for.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In the future that lies ahead,
she will deliver a performance that changes history—
I was certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Even just for that, today's
Japanese Derby was of immense value.
...At least, that's what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: However, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...If this continues, my journey will likely be cut short."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The autumn season...
Or perhaps the Senior Year...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As time passes, the gap in power between me and that
"storm" of an Umamusume will only widen beyond what it is today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Eventually, even standing on the same stage would become difficult—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And...... I get buried.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Unable to keep up with the cutting edge of the era,
that journey comes to a close—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That fact, too—
I became utterly certain of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey spoke calmly.
His expression remained composed...
carrying an aura that brooked no argument.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize.
I've made the already gloomy mood from the loss even worse, haven't I?
choice_data_list: —Is that really going to stop you in your tracks, Journey?
—Are you going to let that stop you, Journey?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list: I don't want to stop you

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Dream Journey's conviction is surely right.
Her insight is never mistaken."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet that's only... assuming we just
accept the facts as they are.
choice_data_list: Let me think this through with you. There's got to be a way forward.
Let me think it through with you. We'll find a way forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer,
I have already sworn to see the end of this journey together with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "There must be something. Something that will allow Dream Journey to continue her journey from here on out—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The path for her to become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...It's truly reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The road ahead will likely be even harsher...
but please, walk it together with me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to hold a meeting with Dream Journey
to fundamentally re-evaluate our strategy following the Kikuka Sho—
—Pardon me.

I have business with Dream Journey.
Is she in this room?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: This voice is—
choice_data_list: Is it okay to put it in?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes, please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your forgiveness.
I bid you all a good day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, the world-class stayer representing the prestigious Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was completely stunned
by the sudden visit from such a huge name.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I am surprised.
Whatever business could you have with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I received a message for you from a certain someone.
I have come to deliver it to you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“......Thank you very much.
I accept with gratitude.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: This is...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
――To both of you.
Please, do pay a visit to our estate next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall welcome you with everything the Mejiro family has to offer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, good day to you.
Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The visit and departure were so sudden
that I couldn't wrap my head around what had just happened.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was only one clue in this room to understand the situation—
choice_data_list: Just who is that letter from?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: …………Why would she—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon me.
I'm a little perplexed myself. You see—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Because the sender of this message
was Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Will this correspondence bring guidance, or something else?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The golden fragrance drifting from the seal
speaks in total silence—
